findings.note: NHL.com lists Bedard (shoulder) and Byram as out for Chicago and says Commesso could make his season debut here or Sunday. Wolf is expected to start a third straight game for Calgary, and Backlund, Pospisil and Middleton did not skate at Friday's optional practice.

Chicago is 6-14-2 and 0-8-1 on the road; Calgary is only 10-12-1 (6-6-0 at home), lost 4-1 to Minnesota Thursday, and has Zary and Huberdeau out. Likely starter Wolf has a .878 save percentage, below Cooley's .906.

CBS shows Calgary at -164 and Chicago at +137 with a 5.5 total, so the -160 offered is about the market price. Calgary's goal scoring (2.47 per game) is nearly the same as Chicago's (2.43), and no expert pick was visible.
